concerns.text: FR-001 requires a Micro-Corpus of 10M tokens. Tasks T013/T014 implement a 1M token limit per the Plan. There is no task to implement the 10M token requirement specified in FR-001, leaving the spec requirement unimplemented.

FR-009 requires an a priori power analysis for the 10M token / 100 epoch regime. Task T033 implements power analysis for the 1M token / 5 seed regime. No task exists to perform the power analysis mandated by FR-009 for the spec-defined regime.

US-2 and FR-003 mandate training exactly 2 models (1 AR, 1 MDM). Task T025 implements training 10 models (5 seeds x 2 arch). No task exists to implement the 2-model regime specified in the User Story and FR-003.

SC-002 requires measuring correlation against a threshold of |r| ≥ 0.5. Task T034 mentions 'including a check' but does not explicitly implement the pass/fail logic or artifact generation required to verify this specific success criterion.

Task T018 is a meta-task to 'flag a conflict' rather than implement a requirement. It references a Spec vs Plan conflict but does not resolve it by implementing the Spec requirement or formally amending the Spec within the task list.

Task T032 ('Implement HumanEval evaluation script... ensuring HumanEval data is excluded') duplicates the exclusion logic already covered by Task T017 ('Implement HumanEval exclusion verification logic'). This redundancy suggests a lack of clear mapping to unique spec requirements.
